== IMG.02 MRI channel and DCE-phase management ==
Intent: Do not reinterpret contrast phases as longitudinal patient follow-up 
Test: Correct channel order and study timestamps
 BOOK/LECTURE A03 MIT HST.582J | Lecture 17 — Medical image modalities; Lectures 9,12 image processing | https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/hst-582j-biomedical-signal-and-image-processing-spring-2007/pages/lecture-notes/ | verified section
 BOOK/LECTURE A16 DICOM Standard | Image spatial geometry, DICOM SEG and referenced source images; locate exact part/modules for version | https://www.dicomstandard.org/current | standard verified; section number pending
 PAPER P01 MAMA-MIA multicenter DCE MRI tumor segmentation research | https://github.com/LidiaGarrucho/MAMA-MIA
 REPOSITORY R01 MAMA-MIA | https://github.com/LidiaGarrucho/MAMA-MIA 
  Inspect: Read README, nnUNet subtree, download and checkpoint instructions; identify channels, transforms and mask meaning 
  Reuse: Use compatible vetted model inference or verified reference masks 
  Avoid: Do not assume checkpoint availability, licensing or external validity 
  Verify: Run one approved image, compare mask/physical measurements, record resource usage
 REPOSITORY R05 MONAI | https://github.com/Project-MONAI/MONAI 
  Inspect: Inspect transforms, MetaTensor/affine behavior, data readers, metrics and tutorials 
  Reuse: Adopt supported transformations and segmentation metrics 
  Avoid: Do not use unrelated organ models as breast segmentation 
  Verify: Image-mask transforms, invertibility, geometry unit tests
 REPOSITORY R13 Cornerstone3D | https://github.com/cornerstonejs/cornerstone3D 
  Inspect: Inspect packages/tools, viewport, segmentation loaders and examples 
  Reuse: Evaluate direct library integration rather than all of OHIF 
  Avoid: Do not recode entire DICOM viewport layer 
  Verify: Render known DICOM and overlay matched segmentation
 REPOSITORY R14 VTK | https://github.com/Kitware/VTK 
  Inspect: Inspect marching cubes, polydata and mesh export examples 
  Reuse: Adopt supported mesh extraction functions 
  Avoid: Do not infer anatomical truth from smoothing 
  Verify: Known-shape mask-to-mesh geometry test
